reviews.title: Dislike the Changes
reviews.text: Whatever you did to the format, this is NOT good! O used to be able to choose the newspaper whose obituary I’m interested in reading, but now all the names are listed together from all over the place. And one in particular that I wanted to read told me that I had to be a subscriber to read that one. 😡 WHY change

reviews.text:
I have to sign in for every story and still get ads to join. And the family feature doesn’t work at all. My husband has been on the phone and emails 14 times and no resolution 
14 TIMES!
I’m concerned how hard it’s going to be to cancel this garbage

reviews.title: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE
reviews.text: i have a subscription and i want to cancel it, but there’s no way to do it. no one to contact. no letters to the editor to express my disgust with what they choose to entice me with in my emails. no phone number to call. no email address to use. when they send an email with a link to a story i can’t read it until i sign in. of i go to the app to look for the story, its no where to be found. there cant possibly be enough positive reviews for them to have more than two stars. they are really awful. i’m being stolen from because i have no way to cancel my subscription. to hell with this business. it’s a rip off.

reviews.title: Poor performance

reviews.title: Crashes constantly and…
reviews.text: … Limited filtering & searching.  Not great for a paid app.

reviews.title: glitches make app unusable
reviews.text: I click a notification to read a story and the app opens, freezes, and crashes. If I want to actually read a story, I have to search for it myself in a browser. Sometimes the app will work for a moment but then it will freeze and crash. I’ve reinstalled, updated, and everything—this has been an ongoing issue.

reviews.title: Garbage paywall app!
reviews.text: Huge fail and no doubt why this media has failed .  Click bait on most stories and then you get the paywall.  Very liberal and anti Trump/America First hack reporting.  Every story/event they want to charge you for is always available for free elsewhere.  The UK based Daily Mail will have better coverage on local news events than this steaming pile of waste called MLIVE!

reviews.title: How can it be this bad?
reviews.text: Like others say, used to be great but for last 9 months or so it takes forever to load, crashes and is very slow.  Must be their way of trying to force subscriptions.

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: Gets progressively worse with each update. It won’t load without numerous attempts. If it does load, it will crash while looking at an article. There is no way I would subscribe to this nearly useless app.

reviews.title: Won’t load
reviews.text: Totally not loading.  I got it to load once and it froze.  Tried it again…black screen every time.  Good thing I don’t pay for this!!

reviews.title: Almost useless

I can read an article on the website (which is only slightly better) or 2-3 articles in the paper before the app loads one story.

reviews.title: Buggy

reviews.title: Slow loading & missing puzzles now
reviews.text:
Update 11/25/25: app is broken. News not updating, opens on an outdated article instead of home page, tells me I need to subscribe while I already have an active subscription - cannot access some games and others have lost my history. 

Update 11/6/25: puzzles are back, but the INTRUSIVE AD BAR remains. GET RID OF THE AD BAR if you want to get a better rating!!

App loads VERY slooooooowly. Once in, the large white bar for ads is excruciatingly intrusive and gets in the way when trying your work puzzles - speaking of: WHERE DID THE PUZZLES GO? They’re nowhere to be found in the app! 🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬

reviews.title: Slow and unresponsive
reviews.text: It seems that since the latest update this app is almost impossible to navigate. The desired link results in a freeze or at best a very long delay.
